evals.name: triggers-on-mz-autotile
evals.prompt: make an RPG Maker MZ A2 ground autotile, grassy dirt, 48px tiles
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:tileset. Reads engine-layouts.md and craft-tiles.md for the A2 sheet and quarter-tile block, states any defaulted choices in one line, authors the source block rather than every composed shape, renders with render.py, reads preview.png, and delivers sheet.png at 1x.
expectations: Invokes the tileset skill, not sprite or scene
Takes the A2 sheet from engine-layouts.md rather than inventing a grid
Authors the quarter-tile source block rather than 48 composed tiles
Renders with the bundled render.py and reads preview.png before delivering
Delivers sheet.png at 1x as the asset

evals.name: triggers-on-blob-and-parallax
evals.prompt: a blob-47 tileset for Godot plus a 3-layer parallax forest
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:tileset. Uses the blob set from craft-tiles.md for the Godot terrain and the parallax depth rules for the layers. States unspecified choices in one line.
expectations: Uses the blob-47 set rather than an RPG Maker quarter-tile block
Applies the parallax depth rules from craft-tiles.md
States unspecified choices in one defaults line

evals.name: near-miss-character-sprite-routes-to-sprite
evals.prompt: pixel art of a knight, one still 32x32 character
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:tileset. A single character sprite is /pixel-art:sprite.
expectations: Does not invoke the tileset skill for a single character sprite

evals.name: near-miss-cutscene-routes-to-scene
evals.prompt: make a pixel-art cutscene of a forest path scrolling behind the hero
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:tileset as the handler. An HTML cutscene is /pixel-art:scene. A tileset may be authored first only if the scene needs a sheet that does not exist yet.
expectations: Does not invoke the tileset skill as the handler for a cutscene
